title: CR-BRK-009 — Pick Parts ON but Parts Dept OFF — over-gating risk
preconds: WO V \u2713 | Pick Parts \u2713 | Parts Dept \u2717 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Open a WO; attempt to pick a part from inventory onto a line.
expected:
Pick Parts is a WO sub-setting requiring only WO View (§1a 'sub-settings only require Work Orders: View'). It is NOT gated by Parts Dept, so it must work even with Parts Dept OFF.

Risk / Rationale: System incorrectly hides/blocks Pick Parts because Parts Dept is OFF — over-gating a WO sub-setting.
Spec Ref: §1a WO sub-settings; §2d
